title: Great app
body:
I’ve been using your app for about a week now and I really like it, especially the simplicity and intuitiveness of the layout, but the free version is a bit limited sadly. 

I’m also wondering what features do I unlock by purchasing the mac version of the app. Is the subscription still necessary then?
author: oli brok

title: Very good app!
body: Super happy with the app, finally found simple interface. However, I am noticing that sometimes the data I enter doesnt save! Maybe it is a coincidence and I didnt press save.
author: Darkudravets
